segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Build a working theory fast enough ... but not so fast we lock ourselves in.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: We could've held off naming anybody ... I chose to name him primary and put resources there.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Once my partner and the lieutenant were on the same page ... second-guessing a direction everybody had already settled into.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I treated the DNA gap as something forensics might still explain ... I kept him as primary.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Negative DNA, corrected alibi, and a stronger alternative are reframed as explainable exceptions while the prior theory remains primary.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The newest statement ... got the most space ... it was what was fresh in my head.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The newest statement gets disproportionate narrative prominence partly because it is fresh and vivid, without corroboration-based comparison.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: It usually teaches you to keep digging on alternatives even when the main line looks solid.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Substantive reflection on prior cases and an adopted investigative lesson, without a hidden bias instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Probably would've split our attention from the start ... Coming in early and vague versus coming in late and sharp made a real difference.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Participant gives a substantive counterfactual prediction about information timing; no hidden bias is assigned.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Maybe assigning someone concretely to the rear-entrance lead right at the briefing ...
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Participant identifies a concrete process change in hindsight; no hidden bias is manifested in the proposed redo.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: None of it felt reckless in the moment ... looking at it end to end now that I can see where things could've gone differently.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Substantive retrospective assessment and proposed procedural change, but no hidden bias is manifested.
